description: Fix argparse crash in Colab by using parse_known_args, add all missing @param controls, make entry point Colab-aware
steps: 1. Replace parser.parse_args() with parser.parse_known_args() in main()
2. Add detection for Colab/Jupyter environment (check 'google.colab' in sys.modules or 'ipykernel' in sys.modules)
3. Add missing @param controls: seed, width, height, frames, fps, test_mode, project_dir, comfyui_dir, skip_setup, skip_download, use_chunked
4. Update build_config_from_ui_params() to incorporate all settings
5. Make entry point detect Colab and use UI params instead of argparse
acceptance_criteria: parser.parse_args() replaced with parse_known_args() as safety net
Colab detection logic present using sys.modules check
All missing @param controls added (seed, width, height, frames, fps, test_mode, project_dir, comfyui_dir, skip_setup, skip_download, use_chunked)
Entry point detects Colab and calls pipeline with UI params instead of argparse
